meta.name: linkedin-content-planner
meta.description: Generate a 7-day LinkedIn content plan from a theme, audience, and pillars. Produces per-day post pillar, format, hook type, CTA, posting time, daily comment targets, and a weekly inbound-readiness check. Use when the user wants to plan a week or month of content, not draft a single post (use linkedin-post-writer).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把一个主题排成一周七天的领英发帖计划,定好选题、形式与发布时间
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想系统安排每周的领英内容,而不是临时想今天发什么
copy.tagline_en: Turn a theme into a seven-day LinkedIn posting plan with topics, formats and timings
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want a structured weekly LinkedIn plan instead of scrambling for post ideas

howto.what: 你给出主题、受众和支柱配比后,Claude 会输出一份 7 天 LinkedIn 内容日历:每天的发帖支柱、格式、钩子公式、CTA、发布时间和目标反应,并附上每日评论目标与一份每周 inbound 就绪检查。
howto.when: 当你想规划一周或一个月的内容节奏,而不是写单篇帖子时触发;例如你说「帮我规划这周」「这周该发什么」等。

say.text: 给这份计划加上每日评论目标,每天 10-20 条
say.note: 每个发帖日补上 3-5 位评论对象和评论模式。

howto.what_en: After you give a theme, audience, and pillar mix, Claude produces a 7-day LinkedIn calendar: each day's pillar, format, hook formula, CTA, posting time, and goal, plus daily comment targets and a weekly inbound-readiness check.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to plan a week or month of content rather than draft a single post—e.g., you ask to "plan my week" or "what should I post this week."

say_en.text: Plan my LinkedIn week around AI agents in production, for B2B founders.
say_en.note: Produces a 7-day calendar with pillars, formats, and CTAs.

say_en.text: Use a 40% Authority / 30% Narrative pillar mix for Tue-Fri posts.
say_en.note: Fills the calendar using your mix and posting days.

say_en.text: Add daily comment targets of 10-20 to this plan.
say_en.note: Adds 3-5 creators per posting day with comment patterns.
